title: WorkBuddy Launches 'Human-AI Dual Writing': AI Exits the Chat Window and Joins Your Document to Work Together

content_html:
On July 30, the office AI platform WorkBuddy officially launched a major update - the "Human-AI Dual Writing" feature, which for the first time enables real-time collaboration between AI and users within the same document interface, marking the transition of AI office work from "add-on assistance" to the "synchronized collaboration" stage.

Differing from traditional AI assistants that require repeated copy-pasting and window switching, "Human-AI Dual Writing" allows AI to directly enter office scenarios such as documents, spreadsheets, and PPTs. Users only need to select content and input natural language instructions, and AI can complete modifications, formatting, and analysis directly in the original file, with all changes taking effect immediately. This feature is the first of its kind in the industry, supporting both Tencent Online Documents and local Office files (Word, Excel, PPT, MD), truly achieving a seamless experience of "edit whatever you think of."

In practical office scenarios, this feature demonstrates significant efficiency advantages. In document scenarios, users can generate weekly summaries, batch adjust full-text formatting, correct typos, and refine content with just one sentence; in spreadsheet scenarios, AI can automatically generate pivot tables, fill formulas, clean data, mark abnormal values, and output visual charts and analysis reports; in PPT scenarios, it supports unified style, automatic image insertion, page structure splitting, core idea summarization, and voiceover notes generation, significantly shortening the production cycle. According to actual test cases, technical proposal writing was reduced from one day to just a few minutes, market research from one week to a morning, and bid document processing from 3-5 days to half a day, with an overall efficiency improvement of over 10 times.

With the release of this feature, WorkBuddy also launched the "Share Your Usage and Win Prizes" campaign, inviting users to experience "Human-AI Dual Writing" and share real case studies, with the top prize being 2000 points and a Tencent Document seasonal card. The campaign will continue until August 16, 2026.

content_html_zh:
7月30日，办公AI平台WorkBuddy正式推出重大更新——“人机双写”功能，首次实现AI与用户在同一文档界面内的实时协作，标志着AI办公从“附加辅助”过渡到“同步协作”阶段。

与传统AI助手需要反复复制粘贴、窗口切换不同，“人机双写”让AI可以直接进入文档、电子表格、PPT等办公场景。 用户只需选择内容并输入自然语言指令，人工智能就可以直接在原始文件中完成修改、格式化和分析，所有更改立即生效。 该功能业内首创，同时支持腾讯在线文档和本地Office文件（Word、Excel、PPT、MD），真正实现“想到什么就编辑什么”的无缝体验。

在实际办公场景中，该功能表现出显着的效率优势。 文档场景下，用户只需一句话即可生成每周摘要、批量调整全文格式、纠正错别字、精炼内容；在电子表格场景中，AI可以自动生成数据透视表、填充公式、清洗数据、标记异常值、输出可视化图表和分析报告； PPT场景中，支持统一风格、自动插入图片、页面结构拆分、核心思想总结、旁白注释生成，大幅缩短制作周期。 根据实际测试案例，技术方案撰写从一天缩短到几分钟，市场调研从一周缩短到一个上午，标书处理从3-5天缩短到半天，整体效率提升10倍以上。

伴随该功能的发布，WorkBuddy还推出了“分享使用赢大奖”活动，邀请用户体验“人机双写”并分享真实案例，最高奖品为2000积分和腾讯文档季卡一张。 该活动将持续到2026年8月16日。
